headline: Containerized execution and orchestration for reproducible bioinformatics workflows
label: Reproducible Computational Biology Software
summary: Preprints and a published tips article now address containerized, reproducible execution across bioinformatics workflows and bioimage AI deployment.
synthesis: The shared thread is reproducibility delivered through execution infrastructure. PoSyMed, a preprint, is an open modular platform for integrating, composing, and executing bioinformatics tools and workflows with containerized, reproducible execution. BioEngine, also a preprint, is an execution and adaptation layer for running, fine-tuning, and deploying bioimage AI models at scale on laptops, workstations, or clusters, with agent-readable interfaces. A published tips article addresses when software containers fit computational biology work and how reproducibility is weighed against flexibility. What is new is the treatment of execution itself as the engineered object, spanning workflow composition, scale-out deployment, and operational guidance for containers. The summaries report no comparative benchmarks, so performance claims cannot be assessed from this set.
